thread.title: Increased Investor Complacency Set the Stage for the Poor Market Action Today

title: Increased Investor Complacency Set the Stage for the Poor Market Action Today
text:
Increased Investor Complacency Set the Stage for the Poor Market Action Today By intc 
Market players have been feeling better about the market after the strong earnings news from Netflix ( NFLX ) helped to push the S&P 500 out of its recent trading range and over its 50-day simple moving average. The Fed has been a non-issue lately and the emotional reaction to the potential of a trade war had cooled off. All of this helped to create some optimism about a positive reaction to earnings season. 
This increase in complacency set the stage for the poor action today. Concerns about semiconductors and what that means to smart phone sales put pressure on Apple ( AAPL ) and a host of other technology companies. Also a spike in interest rates raised concerns that maybe there will be some increased economic headwinds. 
There isn't any great mystery about what is impacting the market today. The more important issue is whether this is a major turning point or just another hiccup in a market that has had quite a few of them recently. 
Bears may argue that semiconductors are making a major top but there isn't enough evidence to support that conviction at this time. Chips have often been leading indicators of a change in market character in the past but there just isn't enough evidence yet. When Intel ( INTC ) reports earnings on April 26 and some others in the sector provide guidance, then we will have much better insight. Apple doesn't report until May 1 so there will be some time to contemplate the chip issue in the meanwhile. 
While action like we have today may trigger some sell stops it isn't sufficient to suggest that the recent rally is over. Next week when earnings roll in the mood can change very fast. We saw the impact that Netflix had on the market and a number of other companies have the potential to do something similar. 
I have some unattractive action on my screens mainly in bigger biotech names but I'm not looking to be aggressively bearish here. This market trapped complacent bulls but they have had some reason to be complacent and those reasons still exist. Get an email alert each time I write an article for Real Money.
